notes: kb/Work PB5578: §2002:13.16.41.3 GR3: a record's size is in bytes whatever its characters (pb1277: a national position is two bytes) and a variable-occurrence table counts at its maximum: FO-N PIC 9 + FO-T OCCURS 1 TO 4 is 5 bytes, so RECORD CONTAINS 5 is accepted and 4 refused COBOL2010 (§2002:13.16.41.2 SR2).
